title: Moving Like a Hunter
blurb: Roll, sprint, slide, climb and vault: the moves every awakened body has.

steps.text: Hold sneak as you land to roll.
steps.hint: A roll takes the sting out of a long fall.

steps.text: Hold sneak while sprinting to slide.
Press jump at a ledge to climb it.
steps.hint: Ledges up to two blocks high.

steps.text: Run at a fence or a wall and vault it.
steps.hint: Every fence and wall is movement.
